blueprint.title: Auditly Studio — Enterprise AI UX Audit & Design System Governance Hub
blueprint.persona: AI Product Manager & Principal UX Architect
blueprint.businessProblem: Enterprise teams rapidly generate AI prototypes across multiple products, but ship inconsistent styling, poor contrast, missing error states, and unverified business requirements. We need an AI UX Audit & Redesign Governance Hub that evaluates screens against WCAG 2.1 AA, verifies 100% requirement traceability, coordinates 4 Magic Patterns inspiration variants, and enforces human sign-off before React code export.

requirements.title: Automated 7-Dimension UX & WCAG Audit
requirements.statement: Inspect requirement coverage, navigation clarity, scenario completeness, UI states, WCAG contrast, design tokens, and code parity.

requirements.title: Four-Variant Magic Patterns Inspiration Matrix
requirements.statement: Compare 4 distinct structural design directions grounded in shared baseline tokens and verbatim product copy.

requirements.title: Human Approval Gate & Production Spec Export
requirements.statement: Block production React export until a human reviewer approves a variant and all critical UX/WCAG findings pass.

requirements.title: Filter Findings by Compliance Status
requirements.statement: Filter audit items by Pending Triage, Remediated & Approved, or Blocked by Token/Contrast Violation.

requirements.title: WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance & Semantic Landmarks
requirements.statement: Verify all text/background token pairs achieve >= 4.5:1 contrast with keyboard-navigable controls.

requirements.title: Full State Simulation (Empty / Loading / Error)
requirements.statement: Include interactive state toggles for empty audit queues, MCP streaming states, and API timeout recovery.

userStories.iWant: to compare 4 divergent Magic Patterns directions alongside automated WCAG & requirement coverage scores
userStories.soThat: we select a design direction based on measurable UX quality rather than subjective guesswork
acceptanceCriteria: Given a baseline screen and 4 generated Magic Patterns variants
Then each variant displays its requirement coverage, contrast ratio, and state completeness score.

userStories.iWant: to enforce a human sign-off gate that strips Magic Patterns Vite scaffolding and maps tokens to our repo design system
userStories.soThat: production React components remain 100% consistent with our codebase
acceptanceCriteria: Given Variant A passes all 7 UX and WCAG checks
When I sign off at the Human Approval Gate
Then the engine exports named-export TypeScript React code with zero prototype scaffolding.

legacyIssuesRemediated.description: Legacy audit scorecards used #A1A1AA text on #F4F4F5 backgrounds (contrast 2.19:1, fails WCAG AA).
Prototypes pasted hardcoded arbitrary colors and default exports directly into production repos without token mapping.

dimensions.beforeState: Partial (only happy-path table represented; 3/6 requirements missing)
dimensions.afterState: 6/6 FR & NFR requirements mapped in Traceability Matrix
dimensions.evidence: FR-01 -> EvidenceInspectionCard, FR-02 -> ReviewerDecisionBar, FR-03 -> SyncOutageRecoveryBanner, FR-04 -> StatusFilterSegmentedControl, NFR-01 -> AccessibleWorkspaceShell, NFR-02 -> StateSwitcherToolbar

dimensions.beforeState: Fragmented across modal popups without persistent context
dimensions.afterState: Structured Split Operations Canvas with segmented status filter and persistent inspection rail

dimensions.beforeState: Single unconfirmed click with no revision or idempotency guard
dimensions.afterState: 3 end-to-end Gherkin user stories (Triage, Approval, Idempotent Recovery)

dimensions.beforeState: Missing empty state and missing HTTP 503 outage recovery banner
dimensions.afterState: All 4 operational states (INTERACTIVE, EMPTY, LOADING, ERROR) explicitly implemented and switchable
All token pairs pass WCAG 2.1 AA (min 6.7:1 >= 4.5:1) + semantic landmarks & focus rings

dimensions.beforeState: Arbitrary unmapped colors and inconsistent border radii
dimensions.afterState: 100% mapped to Northstar Enterprise Design System v2.4.0 (10px cards, 6px controls)
dimensions.evidence: Tailwind config + CSS custom properties verified

dimensions.beforeState: Leaked prototype scaffolding, mock Unsplash URLs, and default exports
dimensions.afterState: Named TypeScript exports, zero `any`, strict Tailwind import order, clean data interface
